authorization: User explicitly authorized parallel private game instances up to100, automatic private windows, full CPU, and continued recovery. This policy removes an accidental serialization/abort condition; source and owned-process checks remain.
owned_game_requirements: Exact owned PID, start time, executable path/hash, slot, private profile, runtime inputs and named scoped event handles remain mandatory.
Never inject global or physical keyboard input; never stop or mutate a foreign game.
Preserve normal runtime/config/save/log identity and every failed predecessor receipt.
Shared output files such as resource dumps require existing mutex and hash ownership.

other_game_policy.census: Informational observations of current processes; a zero-game snapshot is never a promise that no authorized sibling will launch later.
other_game_policy.known_campaign_peer: Accept dynamically when exact PID/start/image/slot identity matches that actor's actual owned handoff and the already-approved private packet. Retain the evidence at first observation; no new Root approval or full manifest revision for a new PID.
other_game_policy.foreign_game: May coexist. Do not interact with it. Do not abort the owned run solely because another game exists. Abort/hold for a demonstrated collision with the same writable profile, slot, named input handles or unprotected shared output, or for the owned process's real integrity/semantic failure.
other_game_policy.monitor: Do not classify the already-authorized Deformation/Props/Resource/builder sibling as an unreviewed game solely because it was absent from the prelaunch census. The prior empty allowlist was a harness defect, not an authorization limit.
other_game_policy.capacity: Up to100 distinct owned instances authorized by the user, bounded by actual local memory/storage needs. Small baseline storage envelope still applies to its eligible slots, not all other games.

storage: Compute immutable planned peak/floor once from the exact run outputs. Compare fresh available bytes against that budget. Do not require equality between separate live free-space snapshots.
implementation_review: Owners may make the narrow concurrency policy correction in private successors. One designated peer reviewer checks exact owned input/profile protections and known-peer/foreign-noncollision behavior. Proceed under that approval without another Root/human roundtrip.
